<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/plugin-api/ai/proposals/{id}/mark-run-in-terminal"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



For the terminal-docked assistant only. The command is typed into the user's already-open SSH session client-side, not re-run over a pooled connection here; this just marks the proposal applied with the output the client captured, so the card and the /apply path stay in sync without running the command twice.
